integrity.proof: Symbolic inclusion-exclusion, congruence and parity-conditional witnesses establish the infinite-family result.
integrity.reproduction: Self-contained integer checker and signed-spectrum certificate for widths two through five; exact arithmetic substitutions through width one hundred.

limitations: Applies to binary edge-direction indicators of complete bipartite graphs with exactly three vertices on one shore and at least two on the other.
The every-frequency product formula is exact; an all-width histogram by signed multiplier level is not claimed.
No result claimed for four or more vertices on the fixed shore.
Scientific review is internal to the present mathematical argument; independent validation and global historical priority have not been performed.
title: Sharp Walsh conditioning of acyclic orientations of \(K_{3,n}\)
